video_css.note: Place the complete recording in display_box_overlay. fill makes only a 0.4% ratio adjustment; do not crop. Rounded clipping is necessary to prevent live pixels leaking around transparent outer phone corners.

transparent_display_hole.description: Rounded physical display, fully transparent between normalized status and home-indicator strips; no frozen webpage/URL/bottom-toolbar content.

status_band.note: Original source-screen status ends around 5.57%; retained strip is 5.71%, ~1.85 encoded pixels extra, confined to browser chrome, not website UI.

phone_overlay.normalization: Reference screenshot status clock, signal, Wi-Fi, yellow battery, camera, and white home indicator are decorative normalized chrome, not recording-time evidence. Actual website UI remains live through alpha-zero window. Original recordings are unchanged.

rim_annotation_repairs.method: linear interpolation from immediate clean rows, turquoise pixels only
linear interpolation from immediate clean rows, turquoise pixels only

phone_overlay.exterior_alpha: Per-row white-matte extraction only outside the first/last <220 luminance chrome core; preserved opaque silver highlights inside. Transparent corners and anti-aliased edges, not a white rectangle.
caveats: Original reference is a raster image, so hardware sharpness is limited to its 440px extracted width.
Two four-pixel turquoise annotation crossings were locally repaired from adjacent reference rim rows.
Normalized status band is 49px (5.71% of display), with original Dynamic Island retained; normalized bottom home strip is 18px (2.10%).
A tiny black anti-aliased edge replaces the reference website-white mixed boundary pixels, avoiding frozen-content halos.
The bb-waitlist recording sometimes collapses browser chrome; the minimal18px bottom home strip overlays a small edge of page imagery there, while original media remains unchanged.

desktop_browser_frame.presentation: Decorative HTML/CSS Chrome-style frame; tabs, macOS window dots, and address bar are aria-hidden and noninteractive. Original homepage video is unchanged.
